questions.stem: Painless late bleeding, placenta over the opening. What do you not do?
questions.explanation: A digital exam can start a bleed you cannot stop. Image first.

questions.stem: A painful late-pregnancy bleed, a tight uterus, and clotting tests coming apart suggest:

options.text: Abruption, and watch for consumed clotting factors

questions.explanation: Pain plus a tight uterus plus consumed factors: abruption.

questions.stem: A positive pregnancy test, an empty uterus, and pelvic pain. Next worry?

options.text: A normal early pregnancy, so send the patient home
Previa, because all bleeding is previa

questions.explanation: A positive test and an empty uterus: think ectopic.

questions.stem: Testicular torsion should be treated as:

options.text: A problem that can always wait a week
A simple digital exam of the cervix

questions.explanation: Do not wait for swelling to declare itself.

options.text: Is excluded if any Doppler flow is seen
Can still be present even if flow is seen

questions.explanation: The history and the pain decide, not a single reassuring trace.

questions.stem: Pelvic infection that causes right-upper or shoulder-tip pain may have reached:
questions.explanation: Perihepatitis can follow a pelvic infection.

questions.stem: Bleeding after menopause should be treated as:

options.text: A simple dry-tissue problem with no further look
Endometrial cancer until the lining is evaluated / sampled

questions.explanation: Do not stop at a simple explanation. The lining needs a look.

options.text: Painless, with the placenta over the opening
Painful, with a rock-hard uterus and consumed factors as the first picture

questions.explanation: Painless late bleeding: think previa and do not do a digital exam.

options.text: Painless, with a placenta clearly over the os and no tightness
Painful, and the bleeding may be hidden

questions.explanation: The uterus can be tight, and clotting factors can be consumed.

options.text: Do not do a digital exam if previa is possible.
A positive test and an empty uterus: think ectopic.
Ovarian torsion is excluded whenever Doppler flow is seen.

questions.explanation: Ovarian torsion can still be twisted even if flow is seen.
